description:
During the adversarial code review of complexity batches 8-10, several
pre-existing issues were identified in the refactored functions. These were
faithfully carried over from the original code (not introduced by the
refactoring) but are now more visible and worth addressing.

Grouped by severity and module:

## WARNING-level (7 items)

### Query plan comparison gaps (comparison.py)
1. _OPERATOR_COMPARATORS missing Limit (limit_count, offset_count) and
   Project (projection_expressions) comparators - first-class LogicalOperator
   fields silently ignored during plan comparison
2. Aggregate comparator only checks aggregation_functions, ignores group_by_keys
3. Set difference output in _compare_set_diff is non-deterministic (list(set - set))
   - affects snapshot test stability

### Visualization null safety (visualization.py)
4. _format_physical_properties calls phys.properties.get() without guarding
   against phys.properties being None - AttributeError when show_physical=True
   and PhysicalOperator has properties=None

### Exception chain loss (primitives/catalog/loader.py)
5. raise error_class(...) without `from exc` in expected_rows_affected
   int() parsing - loses original TypeError/ValueError context

### Analysis edge cases (ranking.py)
6. _normalize_scores produces NaN when float("inf") is present in raw scores
   (platform with no query times) - NaN propagates into composite rankings

### CLI truthiness (benchmarks.py)
7. spec.default truthiness check on choices branch (line ~1414): falsy defaults
   like 0, False, "" silently overridden by spec.choices[0]

## INFO-level (selected actionable items)

### Timing domain mismatch (maintenance_test.py)
8. _execute_maintenance_operation uses mono_time() for start but time.time()
   for end - operation.duration is cross-domain nonsense. Should use
   mono_time()/elapsed_seconds() consistently.

### Stub function naming (runner.py)
9. _execute_single_stream only parses stream file comment headers, never
   executes SQL - function name and result dict (success=True,
   queries_successful=N) are misleading

### Docstring gaps
10. _validate_query_overlap/_detect_outliers docstrings understate mutation
    side-effects (they modify caller-owned lists in-place)
11. _compute_raw_scores docstring doesn't document float("inf") behavior
